## Objective
- “웹툰 나혼랩이나 귀멸에 칼날 같은 능력이 있는것들을 주제로 성장하는 로블록스 게임을 만들어줘” — build a complete, playable growth-focused Roblox-inspired game with supernatural powers.

## Requirements
- Build it now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.
- Provide a playable game and save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport at most 1280px wide).

## Decisions
- Created an original Korean action RPG, “균열의 계승자 — Riftbound,” as a browser-based game with an original setting and abilities.
- Gameplay concept: choose between Veil and Storm sword styles, clear three increasingly difficult waves, gain XP/levels, select upgrades, and defeat a boss.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `index.html` with Korean-language menus, HUD, class selection, upgrades, pause/result screens, and mobile controls.
- Added `style.css` with responsive styling and game HUD/interface.
- Began `game.js` with canvas game mechanics and rendering.

### Active
- `game.js` is incomplete: the last edit added game logic and drawing functions but stopped before event handlers, keyboard/touch input setup, and the animation loop.
- No browser testing or screenshots have been run.

### Blocked
- Game cannot be considered playable until `game.js` is completed and checked for syntax/runtime issues.

## Next Move
1. Continue `game.js` with animation frame loop, menu/class button handlers, pause/retry handlers, keyboard and touch controls, portrait layout behavior, then close the IIFE.
2. Run the project and test startup, movement/combat, skills, XP/level-up, wave progression, boss victory, and defeat/retry.
3. Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot; fix any issues found.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: game UI and DOM elements expected by the script.
- `style.css`: responsive layout and visual styling.
- `game.js`: current partial game implementation; finish it before testing.
- `start.sh`: project startup script.

## Important Context
- `game.js` currently ends after `draw()` and has no `requestAnimationFrame` call or input/event handlers; the page UI will not respond yet.
- Changes are uncommitted.

## Objective
- Complete and validate the browser-playable original Korean action RPG “균열의 계승자 — Riftbound,” including combat, upgrades, waves, and a boss.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification and make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- Use an original setting with two selectable styles: Veil and Storm.
- Deliver a browser-based canvas RPG with keyboard and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added Korean-language menus, HUD, class selection, upgrades, pause/result screens, and mobile controls.
- Implemented combat, waves, upgrades, rendering, UI/event handlers, keyboard/touch input, audio toggle, and animation loop.
- Added per-wave kill tracking, XP carryover, rank updates, and mobile portrait orientation handling.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Browser loaded the menu and game HUD; saved `screenshots/riftbound-menu.jpg` at 1050×793.

### Active
- Resolve browser click interception: clicking `button[data-class='storm']` timed out because the `#game` canvas intercepted pointer events.
- Verify combat, skills, XP/level-up, wave progression, boss victory, and defeat/retry; capture and inspect a gameplay JPEG.

### Blocked
- Gameplay flow testing is blocked until the menu buttons can be interacted with in the browser.

## Next Move
1. Investigate why the welcome overlay does not receive clicks above the canvas; browser computed `.welcome` position as `static` and `z-index` as `auto`, despite `.screen` CSS specifying absolute positioning and `z-index:5`.
2. Retest class selection and starting the game, then exercise core gameplay/progression.
3. Save and inspect a gameplay JPEG at a viewport no wider than 1280px; fix any issues and rerun browser and syntax checks.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Core gameplay implementation and browser event handling.
- `index.html`: Game UI and DOM elements used by the script.
- `style.css`: Layout, screen overlays, and controls; likely relevant to the click interception.
- `screenshots/riftbound-menu.jpg`: Existing menu screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Browser is available at `http://localhost:3000`; menu load showed only a missing `/favicon.ico` 404.
- `playwright-cli` testing at 1050×793 confirmed HUD visibility after starting via page evaluation, but browser pointer clicks on the class selector were intercepted by the canvas.

## Objective
- Complete and validate the browser-playable original Korean action RPG “균열의 계승자 — Riftbound,” including combat, upgrades, waves, and a boss.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification and make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- Use an original setting with selectable Veil and Storm styles.
- Deliver a browser-based canvas RPG with keyboard and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented Korean-language menus, HUD, class selection, upgrades, pause/result screens, mobile controls, combat, waves, XP and rank progression, and boss.
- Fixed malformed CSS gradient in `style.css` that prevented parsing subsequent rules, including `.screen` and `[hidden]`.
- Verified class selection and starting; HUD appears at 1050×793 with wave 01/03 and quest 0/5.
- `node --check game.js` passed; browser console showed no gameplay errors.
- Verified attacks, skills, XP/level-up upgrade selection, and progression from wave 01 to wave 02.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/riftbound-gameplay.jpg`.

### Active
- Validate continued wave progression, boss appearance/victory, and defeat/retry.

## Objective
- Complete and validate the browser-playable original Korean action RPG “균열의 계승자 — Riftbound,” including combat, upgrades, waves, and a boss.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification and make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- Use an original setting with selectable Veil and Storm styles.
- Deliver a browser-based canvas RPG with keyboard and touch controls.
- Improve melee accessibility by automatically facing the nearest enemy within range.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented Korean-language menus, HUD, class selection, upgrades, pause/result screens, mobile controls, combat, waves, XP and rank progression, and boss.
- Fixed malformed CSS gradient in `style.css`.
- Added nearest-enemy attack targeting and improved combat balance, including increased player health/damage and reduced enemy health/damage.
- Validated progression through all three waves and boss defeat to the victory screen; victory showed 13 kills and level 3.
- `node --check game.js` passed after the latest changes.
- Captured JPEG screenshots at 1050×793, including `screenshots/riftbound-gameplay.jpg` and `screenshots/riftbound-victory.jpg`.
